vulnerabilities.title: Vulnerability Management
vulnerabilities.description: Track discovered vulnerabilities through their lifecycle. Required by CIR 2024/2690 Art. 6.10.
vulnerabilities.helpText: Log vulnerabilities found through scans, pentests, or advisories. Track triage, treatment decisions, and resolution. CIR requires vulnerability handling as a separate documented process from patch management.
vulnerabilities.empty: No vulnerabilities recorded yet. Add your first vulnerability.
vulnerabilities.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this vulnerability?

fieldDescriptions.cveId: CVE identifier if available (e.g., CVE-2024-1234). Leave empty for internally discovered vulnerabilities without a CVE.
fieldDescriptions.title: Brief description of the vulnerability (e.g., 'SQL injection in login form', 'Outdated TLS 1.0 on web server').
fieldDescriptions.description: Detailed description: affected components, versions, potential impact, and exploitation conditions.
fieldDescriptions.severity: CVSS-based severity rating: critical, high, medium, or low.
fieldDescriptions.cvssScore: Optional numeric CVSS score (0.0-10.0) for precise prioritization.
fieldDescriptions.source: How this vulnerability was discovered: scan, pentest, bug bounty, vendor advisory, or internal review.
fieldDescriptions.assetId: Asset affected by this vulnerability, if applicable. Select from the asset register.
fieldDescriptions.status: Current lifecycle status: discovered, assessed, treating, resolved, accepted (risk), or mitigated (compensating control).
fieldDescriptions.discoveredAt: Date when the vulnerability was first identified.
fieldDescriptions.treatmentNote: What is being done to address this vulnerability (patch, configuration change, compensating control, etc.).
fieldDescriptions.acceptanceReason: If accepting the risk, document the justification per CIR 6.6.2. Required for status 'Accepted'.
fieldDescriptions.resolvedAt: Date when the vulnerability was resolved, accepted, or mitigated.
